previousValue: UGC stands for user-generated content. AI UGC adapts familiar creator formats, such as product introductions, demonstrations and unboxing videos, using AI presenters, generated visuals and scripted dialogue. For a business, it is a way to explain what a product does, who it is for and how it can be used through a short video.

Start with a product link, a photo or a written idea. In AIVideosUGC, choose a scene, prepare a product script and select an AI presenter where the format calls for one. Use your own product information to shape a video for a product launch, a social ad or a product-page introduction.

Explore the four formats below to choose how you want to introduce your product. Each format provides a different starting point for the story, from a direct product explanation to a demonstration or packaging reveal.

previousValue.d: Introduce your product through a script spoken by an AI presenter. Focus on the main features, intended audience and everyday uses, so viewers can understand the offer before exploring the details.
Build a short story around a customer need. Explain the relevant product feature and illustrate how it could help in that situation, using product information you can support.
Plan a short sequence around a particular use, setup step or visible feature. A focused demonstration gives shoppers context and helps them understand how the product could fit into everyday use.

Plan an opening sequence that reveals the product and highlights its packaging or visible details. Use your actual product information to shape an unboxing introduction for a new launch or social post.

Create AI videos from a single product photo. Add a description to guide the scene and movement, then generate dynamic product visuals for ads, social posts and launches without a camera crew.
Turn a written idea into an AI video. Describe your product, audience and key message, then refine an editable storyboard before generating the shots you choose for your campaign.
Create product videos with AI presenters and generated scenes in one workspace. Choose a scene, refine your brief, compare shot versions and assemble a video for your product page or social channels.
